run_score_main: run the score module to compute log probabilities for tokenized sequences from a checkpoint
create_sequences_iterator: create an iterator over pretokenized sequences from a file with optional EOS appending
call_model_score: call the JAX-compiled model to compute log probabilities for a chunk of tokenized data
get_dictionary_and_ranges: get a token dictionary and type ranges for terminals and non-terminals from a tokenizer
load_checkpoint: load a model checkpoint containing config and parameters for scoring
